hero.title: SERVICES BUILT FOR BRANDS THAT NEED TO BE SEEN, HEARD, AND REMEMBERED.
hero.subtitle: Kuanzia design na print hadi film, photography, audio, digital campaigns, na studio training, Tripod hubadilisha ideas kuwa kazi ya ubunifu tayari kwa production.

intro.title: Huduma 12 zimepangwa kama production wall moja.
intro.body: Kila zone ina media frame, service numbers, na njia ya moja kwa moja ya kuanza brief bila kurudi kwenye cards ndogo nyingi.

designBrand.title: DESIGN & BRAND
designBrand.body: Ukuta wa mbele wa studio: identity, visual language, na execution tayari kwa print.

visualProduction.title: VISUAL PRODUCTION
visualProduction.body: Film, stills, aerial coverage, na live delivery vimepangwa kama mfumo mmoja wa capture.

soundStudio.title: SOUND & STUDIO
soundStudio.body: Recording, production, podcast sessions, na mafunzo yanakaa juu ya desk moja ya studio.

digitalGrowth.title: DIGITAL GROWTH
digitalGrowth.body: Digital support inabaki imeunganishwa na campaign, si kitu kilichotengwa na studio.

graphicDesign.title: Graphic Design
graphicDesign.description: Layouts kali, campaign graphics, na brand surfaces tayari kwa rollout.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Identity direction inayofanya brand iwe wazi na ikumbukwe.

printing.title: Printing
printing.description: Posters, packaging, na vipande vya campaign vinavyoandaliwa kwa production.

photography.title: Photography
photography.description: Portrait, product, na event stills zinazorekodiwa kwa campaigns na archives.

videography.title: Videography
videography.description: Cinematic coverage, edits, na branded motion zinazojengwa kwa screens.

droneCoverage.title: Drone Coverage
droneCoverage.description: Aerial coverage inayopanua story na scale ya shoot.

liveStreaming.title: Live Streaming
liveStreaming.description: Multi-camera signal support kwa launches, events, na live moments.

audioRecording.title: Audio Recording
audioRecording.description: Recording sessions safi kwa voice, music, na creative direction.

musicProduction.title: Music Production
musicProduction.description: Beats, arrangement, na studio shaping vinavyojengwa kuzunguka final sound.

podcastRecording.title: Podcast Recording
podcastRecording.description: Voice-led sessions zenye studio setup inayoweka mazungumzo yakiwa safi.

digitalMarketing.title: Digital Marketing
digitalMarketing.description: Content systems na rollout strategy vinavyoisogeza campaign mbele zaidi.

instrumentTraining.title: Instrument Training
instrumentTraining.description: Mafunzo ya vitendo yanayounganisha rehearsal, confidence, na nidhamu ya studio.

process.title: Kutoka brief hadi delivery kwa timeline moja ya studio.
process.body: Sehemu hii inakaa kama production board ya Tripod: hatua wazi, numbering thabiti, na handoff isiyovunja direction.

steps.title: Brief Lock
steps.description: Tunafunga message, audience, deliverables, na production priority mapema.

steps.title: Creative Direction
steps.description: References, formats, timing, na visual au sound direction vinawekwa sawa.

steps.title: Production / Design / Record
steps.description: Cameras, layouts, print prep, au studio sessions husogea kwenye board moja.

steps.title: Edit / Print / Package
steps.description: Assets zinaboreshwa, ku-exportiwa, kuchapishwa, au kuandaliwa kwa campaign.

steps.title: Launch / Deliver
steps.description: Kazi ya mwisho hukabidhiwa ikiwa tayari kwa posting, screening, printing, au rollout.

digitalSupport.title: DIGITAL SUPPORT INAWEZA KUFUATA CAMPAIGN BILA KUTAWALA UKURASA.
digitalSupport.body: Ikiwa campaign inahitaji landing page, content system, au launch support, tunaweza kuiunganisha baada ya core production kuwa wazi.
digitalSupport.label: DIGITAL SUPPORT

cta.title: BRING YOUR NEXT PROJECT INTO THE STUDIO.
cta.body: Anza kwa WhatsApp na service moja, production zone moja, au brief nzima. Tutakusaidia kuiweka kwenye route sahihi.

featuredDevelopment.title: ONE BRIEF. MULTIPLE DISCIPLINES.
featuredDevelopment.description: Campaign moja inaweza kuhitaji design, stills, video, live coverage, audio assets, na rollout materials. Hapa Tripod huifanya production desk nzima ifanye kazi kama system moja.
